newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says to release next tankan survey on June 25.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says to release next tankan survey on June 25.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will release the results of its next quarterly survey of corporate sentiment, or "tankan", at 8.50 a.m. on June 25 (2350 GMT on June 24), a BOJ spokesman said on Wednesday.
The BOJ spokesman also said that the early release of the tankan did not indicate a change in the central bank's monetary policy.
The BOJ had previously said it would release the next tankan in early July.
"The early release was based on our expectations that we may be able to collect data from corporations earlier than usual," the BOJ spokesman said.

He said corporations are apparently able to submit answers to the BOJ earlier than in the previous survey conducted in March, when they were busy drawing up business plans for the fiscal year that started on April 1.
He said the early release also reflects the BOJ's recent efforts to release data as soon as it is ready.
